Support implementation, testing and monitoring of Conditional Access policies under approved governance and change control. Administer user access rights and role assignments associated with RBAC, privileged access and identity governance standards. Support identity governance activities including access reviews, entitlement reviews, inactive account review and privileged access monitoring. Monitor identity-related alerts, risky sign-ins and suspicious authentication activity, and escalate or respond in accordance with incident procedures. Maintain emergency access, administrative account and service account controls in accordance with approved standards. Azure and Cloud Platform Support Provide operational support for Microsoft Azure services within the responsibilities assigned to the ICT function. Assist with Azure subscription, resource group, access, policy, monitoring, tagging, cost-awareness and governance activities. Support Azure-hosted virtual machines, storage, networking, backup, monitoring and related services where deployed. Apply approved RBAC, security, logging, backup, resilience and configuration standards to cloud resources. Participate in cloud migrations, service onboarding, technical assurance and operational handover activities. Investigate cloud service incidents and coordinate escalation to service owners, suppliers or Microsoft support where required. On-Premises Infrastructure and Core Services Administer and support day to day operation of assigned infrastructure including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate, file, print and related infrastructure services within delegated authority and documented procedures. Support hybrid integration between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity synchronisation and authentication dependencies. Perform user, group, computer, shared resource and permissions administration in accordance with approved access controls. Support server, storage, virtualisation and backup platforms, including monitoring, routine checks, restore requests and incident resolution. Apply approved security hardening, anti-malware, encryption, patching and configuration standards to desktop and server platforms. Support business continuity, disaster recovery, backup validation, technical recovery testing and service restoration activities. Maintain accurate configuration, asset, warranty, location, ownership and lifecycle records for ICT equipment and systems. Support asset discovery, software inventory, licence tracking and device lifecycle processes. Promote secure user behaviour and support delivery of security awareness and technology guidance. Prepare and maintain accurate support procedures, system records, diagrams, configuration documentation, knowledge articles and handover material. Participate in planned changes, maintenance windows and service reviews, ensuring testing, communication, rollback and evidence requirements are addressed. Produce service reports, support metrics and technical information as requested, and use trend information to identify improvements. Handle records in accordance with applicable retention, security, data protection and records-management requirements. Projects, Continuous Improvement and Suppliers Participate in ICT projects and service improvement initiatives by providing technical input, testing, and implementation support, documentation and operational handover. Work with business and process owners to define technical needs, deliverables, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria. Provide realistic work estimates, implementation plans, risk inputs and progress updates for assigned activities. Evaluate new technologies and recommend practical improvements that strengthen service, resilience, security, usability or cost effectiveness. Assist with procurement specifications, technical evaluation, licensing, renewals, hardware and software acquisition. Coordinate with managed service providers, vendors and outsourced support partners, monitoring the quality and timeliness of assigned service delivery. General Accountabilities Provide courteous, inclusive and professional service to users and stakeholders. Preserve confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgement when handling privileged, operational, personal or security-sensitive information. Maintain technical knowledge through continuous learning and knowledge sharing Provide emergency ICT support outside normal working hours where required to protect service continuity, respond to urgent operational issues or support approved business requirements. Undertake other duties appropriate to the role as assigned by the Manager, Information Technology, or their designate. Reporting and Relationships Reports to: ICT Service Delivery Manager, or their designate. Direct reports: None PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential: Qualifications and Experience An ICT-related diploma, degree or equivalent professional experience. A minimum of five years relevant experience in an enterprise, regulated, government, critical infrastructure or similarly complex ICT environment. Demonstrable experience providing frontline user support and Level 1 and Level 2 technical support in a service desk or enterprise ICT setting. Experience supporting Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 applications, user accounts, mobile devices and common enterprise peripherals. Experience administering or supporting on-premises Active Directory and core Windows infrastructure services. Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365 tenant services and Microsoft Entra ID. Experience diagnosing incidents, documenting technical work and managing tickets through to resolution or effective escalation. Experience applying cybersecurity controls, patching, endpoint protection, secure configuration and access-management principles. Experience working with suppliers, support partners and technical specialists to restore or improve
